data.name: Huiyu Party Run
data.detailed_description:
═══════════════════════════════════════

Huiyu Party Run

The Ultimate Party Chase Game

═══════════════════════════════════════

A few friends, a few minutes, one laugh-out-loud chase.

Huiyu Party Run is a feel-good party game built for get-togethers — no skill ceiling, no long grind, just grab your friends, hit start, and the fun is already happening.

The rules are wonderfully simple: everyone plays a quick round of rock-paper-scissors together. Whoever throws the unique pick instantly becomes "The Runner" — and the rest of the gang all switch to chasers. Dash, dodge, trip each other up, and try to survive the countdown to pull off a comeback.

Lose? No problem — the next round starts in seconds, and the laughs only get bigger.

🥳 Why This Game Belongs at Your Next Get-Together

🪑 Made for Couch, Dorm & Living-Room Chaos

Plug a laptop into the big screen, gather your friends around, and start a match. No accounts to create, no maps to memorize, no skill trees to grind — just instant fun.

🎉 Pick Up and Play — Learn the rules in seconds, no experience required

😂 Comedy by Design — Wobbly physics, accidental trips, and friendly betrayal drive every laugh

🔄 Fast Paced — Lose a round? The next one is already loading, no penalty waiting

🏠 Variety of Stages — Different party arenas with their own personality, pick your favorite

🎭 A Rock-Paper-Scissors Chase You Can't Predict

Every round begins with a simultaneous showdown — everyone throws their pick at once, and the minority becomes the spotlight. Choose wrong? Try again next round — nobody gets to coast.

🎲 RPS Decides Fate — Collective showdown picks the underdog of the round

🏃 Bouncy Chase — Rubber-boned runners wobble, slip, and trip their way across the map

💨 Trolling Tools — Farts, shoves, and stolen power-ups to ruin your friend's day

🏆 Silly Achievements — A live post-match ticker narrates the dumb stuff you just did

🌐 Online Multiplayer, Bring the Gang Online

Full online multiplayer powered by Steam. Invite your friends no matter where they are — same couch or another continent, as long as Steam is running, they're one click away from joining your lobby.

🕹️ Online Co-op & Versus — Spin up a session whenever your friends are free

📋 4-Character Room Code — Short, shareable, and easy to type into the join box

👥 Steam Friend Invites — Native Steam overlay invites, no alt-tabbing required

🤖 Short on Players? — AI teammates and opponents fill the gaps so you can play solo too

✨ The Party Is What You Make It

We just build the stage — the actual comedy comes from you and your friends. Whether you're genuinely trying to win, or just trying to ruin someone else's round, both are absolutely correct ways to play.

Built with the Godot 4 engine. Online multiplayer powered by GodotSteam 4.20 GDExtension and the Steamworks SDK. Some 3D models and assets are sourced from Kenney, Quaternius (CC0 public domain), and purchased asset packs. Full license texts are included in the installation directory.

═══════════════════════════════════════

Grab some friends. Launch the game. Start laughing.

That's Huiyu Party Run.

═══════════════════════════════════════

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Local AI model requires approximately 1.5 GB of storage space. WebView2 Runtime will be installed automatically if not present.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad-Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Cloud API usage does not require high-end hardware. 8 GB or more system RAM (RAM) is recommended for the best local model experience.
